title: Java 21 Foundations: Records, Collections & Streams
concept: Start with modern Java 21: types and text blocks, classes and records, choosing collections, streams and collectors, sealed interfaces with pattern matching, Optional and exceptions.
description: A beginner course for people who can write a little code and want modern, professional Java 21. Every lesson starts from a small incident at an online bookstore - a BOOK10 coupon that only works in tests, a school order invoiced at -1,294,967,296 VND, a cart that shows one book twice, free store pickup that costs 30,000 VND, a restock job that crashes with ConcurrentModificationException, a sales report that dies on a duplicate key, saved orders that change after checkout, e-wallet fees silently recorded as 0, an order page that crashes on a missing address, a price import that stops at line 37 - and fixes it with Java 21: types and text blocks, classes and records with equals/hashCode, enums and switch expressions, List, Set and Map, streams and collectors, immutable collections, sealed interfaces with pattern matching, Optional, exceptions and try-with-resources, ending with a mini project that puts it all together. 10 lessons with quizzes and Java coding challenges.
